diagnosis: Loopback RX latched recv_buf_data as 0xe0 instead of expected 0xa5, causing tohost FAIL 0xdead. Start half-bit in state 1 uses full cfg_divider (2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) but data/stop states 10/default sample when recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider>>4), i.e. 1/16th of the bit period. This 16x-early sampling mis-aligns bits and corrupts the byte. Root cause is the >>4 divisor in the excerpt.
expected: tohost PASS with uart loopback 0xa5 received correctly, no data mismatch TRAP
